item.title: SC puts new UGC regulations on hold, says can have ‘very sweeping consequences’
item.description: STATE TIMES NEWS NEW DELHI: In a significant development, the Supreme Court on Thursday stayed the recent UGC equity regulations on preventing caste-based discrimination on campuses, saying the framework is “prima facie vague”, can have “very sweeping consequences” and may end up dividing society with a “dangerous impact”.The top court also sought responses by March […]
